text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... This intensity and exhaustion is something else! Still...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't get enough! So this is what the Classics feel like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After running her first Classic race,
Vodka's face
is beaming with
satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-how was that, Scarlet?! Looks like...I came out... ahead, huh? Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking... Even though you're... breathing so hard... Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha. So are you... So how did it feel to
run the
Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I lost, idiot... It obviously doesn't feel
good! But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's completely different... than normal
races... I
really... ran the Oka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classics. The races everyone dreams
of. As
expected, the thrill must be out of
this world.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But Vodka! Don't get carried away just
because
you beat me in one G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There's still a long way to go on the road
to the
Triple Tiara. Things won't go the
same way at the
Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah! If you're that into it, sounds like it's
gonna
be a good race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're on! Make sure you up
your game
by then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: See ya there, rival!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: R-rival...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. What're you showing off for?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, at least your skills have caught up
a little to
your pretentiousness...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer. It's thanks to you I was
able to
beat her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I ran today. I got to see what
she can
bring.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Derby?
choice_data_list_en: What do you want to do about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having a good run in the Oka Sho is
something to
celebrate. But it makes our
next decision that
much more
important...

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! What did you and Daiwa Scarlet
talk
about after the race?

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What do you think about your chances
of winning
the Japanese Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I guess... I'm not quite sure how
I feel
yet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is crazy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought all I ever needed to do was
chase my
dreams... but I guess you never
really stop
dreamin', huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's rivalry with Daiwa Scarlet will
only get
more complicated after the Oka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Run in the Derby or run against her rival.
This
time, choosing both is not an
option.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it's just for now, keep me on for the
Derby.
But...
choice_data_list: 次のレース……とりあえず、どうする？
choice_data_list_en: The next race... what should we do for now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I gotta think for a bit. Actually, would ya
mind
thinkin' about it with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have beaten Daiwa Scarlet, but
a dark,
heavy shadow now casts itself
upon her face.
